captions.detailed: This 3D model is a representation of the classic Android robot mascot. It features a main cylindrical body, two short pill-shaped legs at the bottom, and two cylindrical arms attached to the sides, with one arm raised in a waving gesture. The head is a half-sphere resting on a short neck, complete with two small spherical eyes and two angled cylindrical antennas on top.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric 3D model of the Android mascot figure in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust parameters such as the body height and radius, neck height and radius, shoulder radius, leg spacing, eye radius and height, and the length, angle, and thickness of the antennas. Also, provide a print mode option to lay out the parts flat for easy 3D printing.
captions.factory: The code constructs the Android mascot using basic geometric primitives. The body is built from a cylinder, with shoulder cutouts subtracted using a difference operation. The head is created by scaling a sphere and then cutting off the bottom half with a difference cube/cylinder. The legs are made from a combination of horizontal cylinders and cubes to form rounded, pill-like feet. The arms, neck, and antennas are constructed using cylinders, while the eyes are spheres. The parts are assembled using translate and rotate commands, with a logical switch to toggle between assembled 'preview' mode and laid-out 'print' mode.
